assertions: the rendered Web/Wasm shared form opens account details and clicks the prefix selector, exact option and Save
one rendered Save carries the selected prefix and unchanged phone, then reloads the resulting profile state
the repository mutates only the active session profileId
country, local, normalized, E.164 and legacy phone aliases move together
Web and iOS mutation allowlists preserve the normalized and E.164 aliases
an existing linked Auth actor is updated only by auth_user_id and failure is terminal
an unlinked profile fails closed on any occupied Auth email even when client-controlled metadata names that profile
every phone lookup proves exact PostgREST cardinality before zero or multiple matches may select an actor

historicalEvidence.reuse: The real Android, Web and iOS account-details matrix remains historical evidence for the unchanged common save and reload path; it was not repeated solely because the SHA changed.

limits: No new production profile was mutated for this focal unit.
The new rendered interaction ran in Web/Wasm; Android and iOS compile the shared runtime but do not claim a new native interaction run.
Exhaustive invalid-input and collision validation remains outside this unit.
